writing1.title: Writing 1 · Careers workshop participation data
writing1.prompt: The chart shows the number of students attending careers guidance workshops during four months: September 25, October 37, November 49 and December 64. Write at least 100 words describing the changes, comparing months and summarising the overall trend.
teacherKeyFacts: September has 25 and December has 64 attendees.
Largest monthly increase is 15 between November and December.

writing2.title: Writing 2 · Formal career guidance email
writing2.prompt: Write a formal email of at least 100 words to a local company asking for permission for a small group of Grade Eleven students to visit. Explain the purpose of the careers visit, suggest a suitable date, ask about safety rules and explain what pupils hope to learn. Use a polite greeting and closing.
